title: Journal-based failure atomicity
contract: With a durable undo journal, failed updates restore old value and successful updates commit exactly one increment.
scope: Journal flag, old values 0..2, failure flag; admission journal exists; crash modeled as failure before commit.
assumptions: Only admitted inputs within the finite model; outside-assumption probes are recorded separately and are not contract failures.

obligations.claim: Undo record stores exact prior value before tentative update.
Success increments; failure restores original state.

variants.description: On failure return old journal value directly.
